## Change

Describe the benchmark or platform behavior and its evidence.

## Contracts and compatibility

- [ ] Platform and pack boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Schema, manifest, artifact, evaluator, and pricing versions are correct.
- [ ] Standalone/assisted pipeline and compatibility behavior are explicit.

## Safety

- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic or have documented redistribution rights.
- [ ] No secret, cloud identifier, local path, deployment state, or generated result is committed.
- [ ] Azure changes follow the security baseline and preserve existing configuration.

## Validation

- [ ] Python lint, type checking, tests, and package build pass.
- [ ] Frontend tests, accessibility checks, and reproducible build pass.
- [ ] Bicep and package staging validation pass.
- [ ] Documentation links and repository hygiene pass.
- [ ] Offline example completes with immutable evidence and no universal score.

## Deployment proof

State `Not deployed` or provide app, Kudu, health, readiness, real provider call, and
completed evaluation evidence. Do not use AZD status alone.
